skill_concept: Implement DFS-based blind maze exploration: spawn maze_game.sh as a subprocess, maintain a relative-coordinate map in a defaultdict, drive a DFS frontier with backtracking to cover all reachable cells, and serialize the discovered grid to a text file.
verdict_reason: Both tasks use the identical procedure: spawn maze_game.sh as a subprocess, maintain a relative-coordinate map in a defaultdict, run DFS with backtracking to cover all reachable cells, and serialize the result to a text file. The only structural difference is that the algorithm task loops over 10 maze IDs and accepts a maze_id argument, which is a trivial parameterization of the same core procedure.
weakest_link_reason: This task adds the requirement to loop over 10 distinct maze instances and manage per-maze output files, so the skill must be applied iteratively in a loop rather than as a single one-shot run.
